topNews.text: Ospreys Recover Thanks to ‘Pioneering Pairs’ Who Nest Away From Main Population
topNews.excerpt: Ospreys are recovering in Britain thanks to “pioneering pairs” who prefer to nest away from the main population, according to new research. It could be key to increasing the proliferation of the raptors, which first became extinct in the British Isles in 1916 before recolonizing in 1954.
